notes.title: Something is cooking...
notes.notes: First of all, a huge thanks to YOU for your incredible support and nerves of steel in handling Amber Alert. Since the game shouldn’t stay idle, it’s almost time for the update—which took a while, but oh boy, it’s going to be hardcore. And that’s not all! We’re going all in with an upcoming VR mode—a full VR adaptation.
